claim_boundary: A paired A/B of one env flag on one build, N=128, four repetitions per arm after warmup. Dispatch counts and token identity are exact. The TPS delta is DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE and is reported with its spread. This does not prove logit equivalence, does not prove the flag is safe at other sequence lengths, and does not license extrapolating this class's per-dispatch cost to any other class.

findings.what: the motif census predicted 48 DeltaNet launches would go; the live A/B went 628 -> 580 exactly
findings.why_it_matters: second independent static/dynamic agreement to the integer on this decode path

findings.what: all 128 generated token ids match across both arms and all eight runs, with zero fallbacks
findings.why_it_matters: this is a correctness-preserving change, not a quality trade. Token-id parity is necessary and not sufficient -- it does not prove logit equivalence -- but it is what a free win needs to clear first.

findings.conclusion: there is no single marginal dispatch cost. Charging all 628 at 6.25 us overstates the dispatch term; the honest budget line is a RANGE across classes.
findings.what: 2.884 us per removed dispatch for the DeltaNet BA class, against 6.25 us measured for the MLP/GQA/norm fusion class

findings.recommendation: enable it, on the strength of exact dispatch reduction and token-identity, not on the strength of the TPS delta
findings.what: hcli/hawking-native.sealed-3.14.json fusion_env carries four flags and BA_DELTA is not among them

honesty.contamination: Grok lanes were running; absolute TPS is DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE. The dispatch delta is exact and the pairing cancels most contention.
honesty.effect_size_vs_noise: delta 0.1719 TPS against a worst-arm sd of 0.064, so 2.68 sd. Consistent in sign across all eight runs, but small enough that a single unpaired measurement could not have established it.
honesty.the_first_run_is_kept_and_not_used: run 1 contained a low outlier in the sealed arm that would have reported +1.045 TPS. That number is 6x the effect run 2 measures and is not claimed. It is recorded because discarding a favourable outlier silently is how a 6x overstatement gets into a receipt.

lever_semantics: the honest fused formula; =bad selects an identity decay/beta control and is NOT what was measured

runs.sealed_note: one further sealed sample was a low outlier; the run's reported mean was pulled to 34.32 and its delta to +1.045 TPS, which this receipt does NOT claim
runs.why_not_usable: contains an unexplained low outlier in the sealed arm
